fieldNotes.truckGate: Controlled central entrance off the E-W frontage road: painted multi-lane checkpoint with 'COSTCO FLEET ONLY', 'STOP', 'DO NOT BLOCK' and 'FIRE LANE' lane separation and bollard-lined lanes (z20-z21 imagery). Dedicated fleet vs. visitor/vendor lanes confirm a managed checkpoint.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No discrete staffed booth positively resolved in satellite or Street View; control appears set back inside the property. Costco depots are universally access-controlled, so a kiosk/booth almost certainly exists but could not be imaged - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true as the complement of truckGate=true with no confirmed staffed booth; if a manned booth exists this should flip to guardShack. Uncertain.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Tractors with reefer trailers staged along the road frontage shoulder ahead of the entrance (Street View, Jan 2025).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved interior queue/staging aprons flank the central drive lane inside the entrance, before the docks (z20/z21).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Central spine drive runs ~600 m from the road into the building between the two drop yards; easily holds 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock with loading doors on BOTH long building faces (E and W); trailers backed in along both walls plus the dark-roof cold-dock addition at the north end. Estimated ~120 doors total - 50+ band, count approximate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large organized drop yards (E and W faces) with painted, numbered angled trailer stalls packed with trailers; well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Doors on two distinct opposing building faces (east and west banks) indicate physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron with already-separated fleet vs. visitor lanes and ample paved width to add an express bypass.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Approx 2 inbound lanes painted at the throat (fleet + visitor); exit lanes similar. Approximate.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main cross-dock building plus a smaller detached structure (gate/fuel-island/maintenance) on the central drive; ~2.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Southwest Dallas (Mountain Creek industrial district), inside the DFW metro fabric - Urban.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: 200+ trailers visible across both drop yards and dock faces in z18-z21 captures; approximate.
fieldNotes.coords: Roster coords (32.692336,-96.960506) land on the south yard; recentered to the building/yard center 32.69300,-96.96080. Address 3730 Mountain Creek Pkwy confirmed via web search.
